answer: A building I find genuinely fascinating is the National Parliament House in Dhaka, known in Bengali as the Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban, which is considered an architectural masterpiece. It stands in the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar area of the capital, surrounded by an artificial lake and wide lawns. Designed by the American architect Louis Kahn, it is unlike anything else in the country. What makes it so striking is its bold, [[geometric]] design, using simple shapes like circles and triangles cut into vast concrete walls. Despite its size, it has a strange sense of lightness and elegance, especially when the whole building is reflected in the still water around it. I find it interesting because it manages to be both [[avant-garde]] and timeless at the same time, even though it was completed in the early 1980s. The way natural light filters through the openings is genuinely [[ingenious]], changing the whole feel of the interior throughout the day. It serves as the seat of our government, so it carries real [[symbolic importance]] too. I have mostly seen the interior in photographs, but I once walked around the grounds while visiting my sister, and the scale of it was quite overwhelming up close. Honestly, every time I see it I notice some new detail I had missed before. I think great architecture like this is a form of art, and it is something the country can [[rightly be proud of]]. I would love to see inside properly one day.

followUps.q: Would you like to see inside it?
followUps.answer: Very much. I have seen photographs of the interior, with light pouring through the huge openings, and I would love to experience that in person if I ever get the chance to go inside.

followUps.q: Do you think modern buildings in Bangladesh are well designed?
followUps.answer: Some are, but many new buildings are rather plain concrete blocks put up in a hurry. I think architects should learn from buildings like this one, which are practical but also genuinely beautiful.

note: Named the building accurately (Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban, Louis Kahn, Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, lake); plain marks 'modern' and 'proud' upgraded to 'avant-garde' and 'rightly be proud of'; added 'symbolic importance'.
